# upgrade_refrigeration

## Description
This measure upgrades the refrigeration template in the model to a user selected template.

## Modeler Description
This measure upgrades the refrigeration template in the model to a user selected template. The original refrigeration system will be removed and a new system with the user-defined template will be installed.

ModelMeasure
